- Fedor's chat explicitly corrects "a little brighter": match early-screen style and tone, reduce tense contrast, add friendliness. Therefore this pass changes paint/form modeling and cast shadows, not just color grading.

- 3D is allowed if it matches the illustration style; no source claims the client banned 3D.
- Brandbook second-level illustrations prescribe soft lines, gradients/textures for shadows and limited realism. That chapter concerns portraits; it is not a literal architectural plan or instruction to use flat first-level pictograms.
